table.purpose: Dense data tables and small buttons (13px).

label.purpose: Field labels and table headers (13px/500, secondary colour).

shadows.name: floating-drawer
shadows.purpose: Only floating layer in the build: the mobile nav drawer. Reuse for popovers and modals; nowhere else.

motion.name: color-fast
motion.purpose: Button and nav hover colour change.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All transitions and animations collapse under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action of a page or form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; color: #fff; background: var(--primary, #0b6e69); border: 1px solid var(--primary, #0b6e69); border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover, #08524e); border-color: var(--primary-hover, #08524e); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0b6e69); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #1f2a30); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dde0); border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--row-hover, #f1f4f5); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0b6e69); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled 38px input with hairline border and teal focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #4c6272); } .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; height: 38px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 15px; color: var(--ink, #1f2a30); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dde0); border-radius: 6px; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #b7c0c5; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0b6e69); outline-offset: 0; border-color: var(--primary, #0b6e69); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar link: 18px outline icon plus label; active state is teal wash.
components.html: KalendarBemorlar
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 216px; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink, #1f2a30); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item svg { color: var(--ink-2, #4c6272); } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--row-hover, #f1f4f5); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] { background: var(--primary-soft, #e4f0ef); color: var(--primary-hover, #08524e); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item[aria-current='page'] svg { color: var(--primary, #0b6e69); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary, #0b6e69); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Tone + icon + text; never colour alone.
components.html: To'langan
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ok-text, #176331); background: var(--ok-soft, #e7f2ea); border-radius: 6px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Bordered white section with quiet header row; no shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dde0); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-card-h { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dde0); } .ds-card-h h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card-b { padding: 16px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink, #1f2a30); }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Signature dense table: 13px, 44px rows, sticky header, tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-tbl { width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; font-size: 13px; text-align: left; background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-tbl th { padding: 9px 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #4c6272); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dde0); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tbl td { height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dde0); vertical-align: middle; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-tbl tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-tbl tbody tr:hover { background: var(--row-hover, #f1f4f5); } .ds-tbl .r { text-align: right; }

components.name: KPI Strip
components.description: One bordered row of figures with hairline dividers; no tiles.
components.css: .ds-kpi { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); margin: 0; background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dde0); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-kpi > div { padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-kpi > div + div { border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #d8dde0); } .ds-kpi dt { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2, #4c6272); } .ds-kpi dd { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Shifo's staff app reads like a well-kept ledger: white sheets with hairline rules on a pale cool-grey desk, one deep teal for the things you act on, and ink-dark text. It is built for the registrar's sixth hour on a 1366x768 monitor, so density, alignment and predictability outrank first impressions. Nothing is decorated; every surface is a bordered, solid-colour plane.

Hierarchy comes from weight (400/500/600), size steps of a pixel or two, and hairline dividers, not from shadow or colour. Colour is rationed: teal marks the primary action and the current location, and status hues appear only as icon-plus-text chips.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, border-defined surfaces on a cool grey app background; no gradients anywhere.
One accent (deep teal), used sparingly; status colours carry meaning only.
13-14px dense tables with 44px rows, 15px form fields, 22px page titles.
Tabular numerals for money, times, queue numbers and IDs.
Every status is icon plus text, never colour alone.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only brand colour and appears on the primary action, the current location and focus. If a screen has two teal buttons, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: A state is always tone + Lucide icon + text label, rendered through the Status component.

rules.name: The Solid Colour Rule
rules.body: No gradients, glows or translucent glass. Tints are flat -soft values.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Any number compared down a column or read as an identifier (money, time, queue number, ID) gets the num class (tabular-nums). Default text keeps proportional figures.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400, 500, 600 only. Emphasis is weight, not size or colour.

rules.name: The Border Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Cards, tables, KPI strips and panels separate with line borders. A shadow is permitted only on a surface that floats over content.

dos: Do separate surfaces with 1px line borders and radius 6px (controls) or 8px (containers).
Do pair every status hue with its Lucide icon and text through Status or Notice.
Do set money, times, queue numbers and IDs in tabular numerals.
Do keep one primary action per page header, right-aligned.
Do keep a visible 2px teal focus ring on all interactive elements and honour reduced motion.
Do keep icon-bearing navigation labelled, with Lucide outline icons at 16-20px.
donts: Don't use gradients, glow, glassmorphism, purple/indigo, or dark-mode-first styling.
Don't add shadows to cards or tables; only floating layers may carry the one drawer shadow.
Don't use radii above 8px or large icon tiles above headings.
Don't use emoji or glyph characters as icons.
Don't use weights outside 400/500/600, or Inter/Roboto as the main face.
Don't add Uzbek ornament to working screens.
